title: Complexity Score
description: D-80: the FR-033 artifact (AI §9.1 'Complexity Score — score with itemized factors and weights; reconstructible from displayed basis'; paths: requirement, workflow). The five factor scores are produced at Stage 9 by a generator scoring against the docs/09 §1.5 anchors; the weight, contribution, weighted score and complexity score are fixed arithmetic computed by the pipeline (docs/09 §1.3), so the document always carries the table FR-033 requires and a score shown without it cannot exist. Stage 10 recomputes the arithmetic. Repository-authored per docs/12 D-1, published to ARTIFACT_SCHEMA.
